description: This file defines the interface and class declarations for the GstWebAudioPlayer component, including a factory class, the main player class, and related methods for WebAudio playback using GStreamer. It includes class definitions, method signatures, and external dependencies relevant to the WebAudio player implementation.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayerFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of GstWebAudioPlayer.

classes.name: GstWebAudioPlayer
classes.description: Main class implementing WebAudio playback functionality using GStreamer, including pipeline management, playback control, and thread handling.

methods.name: GstWebAudioPlayerFactory::createGstWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates and returns a new GstWebAudioPlayer instance.

methods.name: GstWebAudioPlayer::setCaps
methods.description: Sets the audio capabilities and configuration for the player.

methods.name: GstWebAudioPlayer::writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data buffers to the pipeline.

methods.name: GstWebAudioPlayer::getQueuedBytes
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes queued for playback.

methods.name: GstWebAudioPlayer::stopWorkerThread
methods.description: Stops and resets the worker thread.
